verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's Computer Use feature explicitly lets it see and operate GUIs on macOS/Windows, complemented by Browser (web actions), Site tools/WebMCP (interacting with website actions), and local Work with computer/file access — a broad, well-documented set of capabilities for operating applications on a user's computer. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of Computer Use specifically (community evidence pack lacks direct testing of this feature, only older/adjacent capabilities).
